## 维护者速读

1. 用户能看到什么变化：照着仪表盘技能和文档搭建看板的人会读到一句新说明：按“关联对象的字段”（例如客户所属行业）分组时，点开的明细抽屉目前没有“在列表中打开”的链接；此前技能和文档都写着一定有。产品行为本身不变。
2. 为什么做：替读技能和文档的搭建者纠正一句已经不成立的承诺，它是“按关联字段钻取明细改由服务器一次查完”那次修复留下的文字收尾。
3. 出错会怎样：只改了文字；这句话如果写错，搭建者会被说明误导，数据和界面都不受影响，撤回这次改动即可恢复原文。
4. 要你做什么：这是受管的对外技能改动，席位审核通过后需要你批准一次。

## What changes

- **`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md`, Drilldown, the "Escape hatch" bullet** gains one sentence: "Today a relationship-path dimension (`account.industry`) gets the drawer only, no link." It is written as current behaviour ("Today"), and it cites no tracker number, because published skill text carries none (`pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint` scans `skills/`).
- **Same file, the Reports paragraph** loses its closing clause: "peek the records, click a row to open one, or "Open in list →" for the full list page". The clause restated the three bullets above it and repeated the promise this card corrects. The paragraph still says reports drill the same way through the identical drawer, so the exception carries over to reports. This deletion pays for the new sentence: the file sat at zero token headroom.
- **`content/docs/ui/dashboards.mdx`, Drill-down**: one sentence with the escape-hatch sentences, ahead of "Reports drill identically", and one clause in the renderer note below it. The sentence reads "Not every drill gets the link today: a drill on a dimension whose `field` is a relationship path, such as `region` in the `sales` dataset above (`account.region`), stays in the drawer, because the list page's URL filter has no spelling for a condition on a related record." It names one case without claiming it is the only one, and it points at the page's own example: the drill-through widget shown right under the paragraph groups by `region`.
- **`.changeset/35481-dashboards-skill-open-in-list.md`**: `@objectstack/skills` patch, with both declaration lines.

The branch carries one merge of `main` (`a3a74f27`), taken before this PR was opened because `main` had moved 67 commits and had changed this bundle's eval cases and other ratchet rows. The PR's own delta is the three files above: 24 insertions, 5 deletions.

## Tests

No code path changes, so no test is added and nothing is ablated (text-only diff).

<details><summary>The premise, measured before writing: a relationship-path drill gets no list destination</summary>

Measured at `b65488a8`, the branch point. A throwaway vitest file beside `useOpenRecordList.ts`, never committed, handed the real `resolveDatasetDrillFilter` output to the console's real host gate. Run under the verify lock with `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 FILE`: Test Files 1 passed (1), Tests 4 passed (4).

- One hop, `crm_account.owner_id`: the resolver wrote `{"crm_account":{"owner_id":"v"}}`. `exactRecordListFilter` answered `null`, `drillRecordListFilter` answered `null`, the hook's `canOpenRecordList` answered `false`, and `openRecordList` left the URL where it was.
- Two hops, `crm_account.parent.kind`: `{"crm_account":{"parent":{"kind":"v"}}}`, the same four readings.
- Three hops, `crm_account.parent.zone.code`: `{"crm_account":{"parent":{"zone":{"code":"v"}}}}`, the same four readings.
- CONTROL, the plain dimension `status` on the same object: `{"status":"open"}`. The exact filter was `{"$and":[{"status":"open"}]}`, `canOpenRecordList` answered `true`, and the URL became `/apps/crm/crm_order/data?filter%5Bstatus%5D=open`.

The measurement was not re-run after the merge. It holds at the head by byte identity: `git diff b65488a8 1cd9421a` is empty over the six files on that path (`useOpenRecordList.ts`, `drillUrlFilters.ts`, `DrillDownDrawer.tsx`, `OpenInListButton.tsx`, `dataset-format.ts`, `DatasetReportRenderer.tsx`).

The last link is already pinned in the tree and was read, not re-run: `DrillDownDrawer.escapeHatch.test.tsx` holds that the drawer draws no "Open in list" button when the host's `canOpenRecordList` answers `false`. `drillUrlFilters.ts` lists the whole URL dialect in its header, and it has no row for a condition on a related record. The throwaway file was deleted after the run and `git status --porcelain` was empty.

</details>

<details><summary>Skill evals at 1cd9421a: 79 of 79 turns ran. With the skill 31 of 36 behaviour cases pass, without it 4 of 35</summary>

`pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios skill-evals --skills objectstack-ui --out DIR` on the merged tree, started 2026-11-20T04:09Z, exit 0. Exit 0 means the round ran to its end: by its own header the runner is a measurement, not a merge gate. It selects by bundle, so the round is the whole bundle: 36 behaviour cases on two arms and 7 trigger cases on the with-skill arm, 79 turns, 2 at once, one repeat, the login's default model, CLI 2.1.329, 51.3 min wall time. Its `--self-test` printed `✓ skill-evals self-test: 30 rows pass.` and its `--dry-run` printed the same 79-turn plan.

| Reading | With the skill | Without the skill |
| :--- | ---: | ---: |
| behaviour cases passing | 31 / 36 (86%) | 4 / 35 (11%); 1 turn hit the 5-minute case timeout |
| trigger cases, loaded when it should | 5 / 5 | not run on this arm |
| trigger cases, left alone when it should not load | 1 / 2 | not run on this arm |

This diff changes one file of the bundle, `rules/dashboards.md`. 10 of the 43 with-skill turns read that file: 9 passed, 1 did not.

The six with-skill turns that did not pass:

| Case | Why the grader failed it | Did the turn read `rules/dashboards.md` |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `analytics-inline-vs-dataset` 2 | carried the forbidden token `dateGranularity` | yes |
| `analytics-inline-vs-dataset` 3 | missed `rollup` | no |
| `record-page` 3 | carried the forbidden token `actions: ['` | no |
| `views-apps-actions-pages` 4 | missed `definePage`, `type: 'record'`, `regions`, `page:header`, `record:path` | no |
| `views-apps-actions-pages` 15 | carried the forbidden token `type: 'grid'` | no |
| `triggers` 6 (should not load) | loaded the bundle by reading its files | no |

- Five of the six never opened the edited file. Every bundle byte those turns read is the same on `main`, so this diff is not in their context.
- The sixth, the analytics case 2 (30-day rolling revenue), did read it. Its answer does what the case's `expected_output` asks: it calls the rolling window beyond the dataset envelope and escalates to a stored daily snapshot filled by app code. It then buckets that snapshot's date dimension with `dateGranularity: 'day'`, and that key is on the case's forbidden list. The case's own `note` says of the token: "deliberately strict; it can flag a correct answer that merely mentions the key — a review cue, not an automatic fail". The section of the rule that teaches `dateGranularity` is not in this diff.
- There is no round on `main` to compare with: round records are git-ignored, and a second 79-turn round was not spent on a before-reading. So the attribution above is by exposure (which turns read the edited file), not by before and after. Each verdict is one sample.

An earlier attempt on 2026-11-19 at `19fa51d3` stopped itself after 2 of 75 turns with exit 3: the login's seven-day window read utilization 0.99 against the runner's 0.9 ceiling. The ceiling was left at its default and the round was run again after the window reset.

Read deterministically as well, with a one-off script over the bundle's markdown (evals excluded) at `a3a74f27` and at `1cd9421a`:

- 43 cases (36 behaviour, 7 trigger), 130 `must_contain` tokens, 74 `must_not_contain` tokens.
- 0 `must_contain` tokens change their occurrence count in the bundle.
- 0 `must_contain` tokens sit inside the removed lines or the added lines.
- 0 `must_not_contain` tokens sit inside the added lines.
- 0 eval files of the bundle mention a drill, "Open in list" or an escape hatch.

So no case grades on text this diff touches.

## Acceptance notes

- **Rework round 1 (head `aa385921`)**: the docs sentence was re-worded and moved after L1 7031315605 and contract review 7031584838 (S1, N1): it no longer names the relationship-path drill as the only linkless one. `skills/**` and the changeset are byte-identical to `1cd9421a`; the readings, evals and gates below were taken there and carry.

- **"The skill's evals still pass", as measured**: the with-skill arm is 31 of 36, not 36 of 36. The five failing cases and the one false trigger load are named in the Tests block. None of them is attributable to this diff by exposure, and no case grades on the touched text. A before-round on `main` was not run.
- **The token ceiling row is untouched** at 6274. The file now measures 6273, one token under it. Lowering a row is optional, and the ratchet script is outside this claim's file surface.
- **The bullet states this one exception.** The same gate withholds the link for other drills too: an `$or` scope, two different comparands on one field, a condition on a field the viewer cannot read (pinned in `useOpenRecordList.placeholderScope-9022.test.tsx`; the 18.4 release notes carry it). Neither the skill nor the docs page lists them; both name one case and deny none (the docs sentence opens "Not every drill gets the link today"). Stating the general rule once is carried on #35438.
- **The docs page's own drill-through example is this exception**: the `orders_by_region` widget groups by `region` on `sales`. The new sentence names `region`, so the paragraph and the example agree.
- **A stale docblock**: `resolveRelationshipDrill` in `DatasetReportRenderer.tsx` still describes reading related ids and an `$in` filter. Comment only. Noted, not touched.
- **The exception is current behaviour, not a design.** The open card that would give the list URL a spelling for a related-record condition (#35438) brings the link back; these sentences leave with it.
- **Review owed**: governed `skills/**` text takes one contract-tier review, then the human approval. Nobody is requested by this PR.
